fut.text: Elspeth Tirel's spark ignites when she is thirteen.
Later, in Nyx, the god Heliod kills her.

som.text: Elspeth Tirel arrives on Mirrodin and at first fights Koth in the Urborg pits, ready to kill him at the sight of the Phyrexian mark until Ajani stops her.

She joins Koth and Venser, but the fear of the Phyrexians overwhelms her: after an ambush by nim in the Mephidross she says she can go no further, and when Vadi rebukes her for her cowardice she hears that she must face her fears and end the threat.
Elspeth returns when a Corrupted Harvester captures Venser and Koth, and the trio escape together.
At Ezuri's camp she threatens the rebel leader when he tries to hold them back, and under Tezzeret's guidance she kills the Phyrexians in a surgery room so that Melira is freed.
When Tezzeret then captures her and Venser, Koth and Melira free them and they reach Karn's throne room.

mbs.text: Elspeth Tirel breaks into Ish Sah and frees her companions, and together they fight Phyrexian butchers and escape through a meat shaft.
In Tezzeret's surgery room she rages and slays every Phyrexian, freeing Melira, who goes on to heal the infected rebels at Ezuri's camp.
Karn asks the group to lead the resistance with Melira, and Venser gives his life and spark to cure the golem.
At the end Koth sinks Elspeth into the ground and shields her from the spellbomb blast so that she can planeswalk away.

ths.text: Elspeth Tirel is left behind by Koth, who tells her there is nothing to come back for, and an Obliterator stabs her before she remembers Heliod and planeswalks to Theros.
There snake priests of Pharika restore her strength, and she kills a deadly hydra in a bitter battle, which wins Heliod's notice and makes her his champion.

When Xenagos besieges Akros, Elspeth saves King Anax, but after the siege Xenagos ascends to godhood and she is scapegoated and exiled, and she and Ajani free Nylea in Nyx, and Elspeth throws her spear into Xenagos's chest, killing him with an arrow Nylea struck.
Heliod, fearing he can be replaced, strikes her down with her own weapon and casts her into the Underworld, where Ashiok's nightmares torment her.
Elspeth awakens with the Shadowspear, shatters Heliod's spear, and Erebos chains Heliod beneath a boulder and gives her safe passage home.

jou.text: Elspeth Tirel flees into the wilderness after the Great Revel, barely escaping Heliod's wrath, until Ajani arrives and the two are reunited at Tethmos.
Together they swear an oath to set things right, and with the mariner Callaphe, who is secretly Kiora, they head for the Temple of Mystery.
Elspeth then faces Xenagos in Nyx armed with Godsend, and she strikes him down.
She fears that her trespass into Nyx will not go unanswered, and she is right: Heliod, afraid of her power, fatally wounds her with her own weapon.

thb.text: Elspeth Tirel drowns in the Underworld until her spark reignites, and the memory of Daxos's death stabs into her soul.
Ashiok feeds on her twisted dreams, but Elspeth pulls Heliod's spear from a nightmare, turning it into the Shadowspear, and drives it into Ashiok.
Klothys, furious that souls are escaping death, creates Calix to deal with Elspeth, and she defeats him each time he blocks her way out.
At the exit she defeats Heliod, Erebos imprisons him and grants her life, and she planeswalks away with Calix following after her.

snc.text: Elspeth Tirel, run through by Heliod with Godsend, is carried to Theros by Ajani, and later she arrives in New Capenna wondering whether this is the home he promised.

Ajani has asked her to learn how the plane survived a past Phyrexian incursion, so when she knocks out four Maestro enforcers beating a shopkeeper, she reluctantly accepts Anhelo's offer of work to gain information.
Xander tells her she must earn what she learns, and she becomes an officer of the Maestros, tasked with infiltrating the Cabaretti.
At the Font she defeats the Adversary's loyalists and takes Giada away with Vivien's help, and the three shelter in a warehouse where Elspeth vows to keep Giada safe.

Mortally wounded in a brawl, she is healed when Giada feeds her Halo, and in the cathedral Giada's transformation into Halo drives Ob Nixilis off and turns Elspeth's broadsword into a Halo-pommeled blade.

one.text: Elspeth Tirel is reunited with Koth, whom she thought dead, and helps lead the strike force into New Phyrexia carrying the sylex.

When compleated Ajani and Tibalt confront her on a bridge, Koth and Melira stay behind to free Karn and Elspeth refuses to run any more, though Tibalt's doubt almost undoes her before she finds her will and knocks Ajani unconscious.
She then drops through the ceiling, runs Jace through with her sword, and takes the sylex.
The sylex explodes as she tries to planeswalk, and she vanishes with it to a point beyond the Blind Eternities.

mom.text: Elspeth Tirel wakes inside a memory of her childhood dungeon, where she kills a beast to save her younger self, and a voice tells her she must choose where to intervene as the planes burn.
She decides that New Capenna has its defenders, finds Theros in ruins with Ajani converting its gods, and weighs saving it against the larger war.

At the Invasion Tree on Mirrodin, Serra appears and says the choice is to keep Nissa occupied long enough for Wrenn to reach the tree, and when Elspeth admits she is afraid, Serra embraces her and remakes her as an angel.
Elspeth arrives in golden armor, blocking Jin-Gitaxias's strike, healing Chandra and Koth, and duelling Elesh Norn, whom she stabs in the shoulder.
She knocks Nissa out of the sky so that Chandra is saved, but a war engine flings her through the gate as Wrenn's portal opens.

mat.text: In the Blind Eternities, Serra bestows the power of an archangel on Elspeth Tirel.
Elspeth emerges and blocks Jin-Gitaxias from compleating the captured planeswalkers, then frees Chandra from Nissa so Wrenn can bond with the Invasion Tree.
She knocks Nissa out so that Chandra can carry her to safety, and she transforms into an archangel and gains immortality.

tdm.text: Elspeth Tirel arrives on Tarkir and tells Narset that dragonstorms have begun appearing across the Multiverse, asking how Tarkir kept them at bay.

When a wild dragon breaks into the school, she dives into its mouth and drives her sword into its skull as monks rescue the children, though Taigam warns that she is an omen and urges Narset to send her away.

Narset refuses and goes with her instead, and at the Crucible Elspeth easily defeats Sarkhan, and she is reunited with Ajani, who confesses that he joined Phyrexia willingly, and she tells him he was forgiven before their fight began, but he walks away.
With Narset she steps into the dragonstorm and through an Omenpath to the Meditation Realm, where they meet Jace, who shatters like glass after he seizes the gem between Ugin's horns.
Back under a sky black with dragons, she tells Sarkhan she is not afraid of him, plunges toward his open mouth, and is saved from the fall when Ajani catches her.
